profile.headline: Software Engineer @Microsoft | Millenium Fellow @UN | LSLS @Google
profile.summary:
An honors senior student at Bentley University pursuing a Bachelor of Science in Computer Information Systems with a double major of LSM: Media Arts & Society (focusing on Marketing), and minoring in Mathematics. I am motivated to lead company success and positive social change through data-driven strategies and innovation. 

Passionate about marketing and technology, involved on campus as a Peer Leader mentoring freshmen and off-campus as an Ambassador for EducationUSA and The Representation Project, I am always on the lookout for ways to make a difference.

Check out my website linked below: 
https://gabriela-hernandez-arias.squarespace.com/

positions.title: Ambassador
positions.description:
• Collaborating and organizing take-overs and features on social media 
• Providing guidance and mentorship to Peruvian students applying to colleges in the US
• Sharing advice about applying and studying abroad in a webinar for 50+ students in Peru

positions.title: Youth Media Lab Editorial Board
positions.description:
• Analyzing the social media strategy and providing useful recommendations  
• Pioneering the Amplify Podcast where innovative change-makers are interviewed and facilitating the Amplify Podcast Episodes 1 & 2

positions.title: Chair of Diversity & Inclusion Committee
positions.description: • Led 15 students to build an actionable framework based on collected data and directing 3 projects that impacted 400+ students

positions.title: Data Insights & Strategy Intern
positions.description:
• Analyzed relevant audience data using 3rd-party platforms (Comscore, Parse.ly, Scarborough) to develop marketing proposals for clients (Hulu, Buick, AirBnB, etc), resulting in sold campaigns
•  Crafted thought starters for branded content proposals and recap decks for sold campaigns
• Created data insights for NYP sales teams, and presented relevant research findings from custom studies
• Revised and customized HTML/CSS code for marketing newsletter sent out to 75+ Post employees

positions.title: Brand Design Intern
positions.description: • Upgraded designs on the Great Jones website and Residents app using Adobe Cloud software, leading to increased User Satisfaction and Ease of Use

positions.title: Marketing Strategy Assistant
positions.description:
• Crafting and implementing a detailed re-branding and marketing strategy for the W. Michael Hoffman Center of Business Ethics, leading to an exponential follower growth rate (500/12)
• Training and guiding new team members to develop new social justice & ethics campaigns

company.name: W. Michael Hoffman Center for Business Ethics

positions.title: Consulting Intern
positions.description:
• Directed vendor acquisitions and designed a responsive and personalizable email pitch for vendors, resulting in the participation of 200+ companies for the Marketplace of the Future event
• Identified inefficient practices by the company and introduced HubSpot's scalable CRM system to streamline interactions with vendors, customers, and other business partners

positions.title: Marketing Intern
positions.description:
• Creating and leading 4 marketing campaigns to expand the reach of social media, increasing followers by 13.4%
• Launching a new branding strategy to connect with students, and designing accompanying graphics using Canva and Adobe Photoshop, resulting in increased engagement 'likes' by 50%
• Introducing Hootsuite Software, automating and increasing the efficiency of the social media posting process

positions.title: First Year Seminar Peer Leader
positions.description:
• Co-directing a class with a Bentley Professor
• Organizing weekly agendas for class
•  Mentoring and advising the students to ensure their mental well-being and guiding their campus involvement

positions.title: Tutor
positions.description: Teaching high school students topics such as Mathematics, French, and Economics up to the International Baccalaureate level, in order to strengthen their school performance.

positions.title: Leadership Program
positions.description:
Leader Coordinator:
     • Managed finances during summer camp in the Young Men’s Christian Association (YMCA) Camp
     • Directed volunteers and held meetings to discuss daily assigned duties

Leader:
     •  Looked after children 6-13 years old, supported teachers in activities such as sports, crafts, and dance, created chants to entertain the children
     • Assisted the staff to organize and undertake activities to promote leadership in the children

positions.title: TEDx Speaker Assistant
positions.description: Assisting TEDxTukuy speaker and artist Chio Flores present her exhibit at the Peruvian TEDtalks

volunteerExperiences.description: Handing out donations at the INEN hospital to children with cancer, keeping them company and entertaining them and their families by playing music.

• Fundraised by organizing activities such as clothing drives, food fairs, and bake sales.
• Participated in the 3-day construction of 6 houses in 2016 (polishing, cutting, hammering, and painting wood) in the Pachacamac district for families in need.
• Supported TECHO clothing and food fair in 2017 by promoting, photographing and recording the event, as well as helping out with the bake sale.
